text_en: In this place, we are the guests. I'm simply responsible for preserving our hosts.
May I help you with something?
Mister Jivan told me this could happen one day.
Proceed, I understand that circumstances require it.
The flower you're looking for is right here. I've been keeping her alive for you.
Please remove her extremely delicately and, above all, acknowledge her sacrifice with respect.
Take her to mister Jivan and tell him that, should he need anything, I'll be here.
